# Buttons, Menus & Toolbars gets its split button and menu tree tiles

## Context

#21140's target lists four tiles for Buttons, Menus & Toolbars: button, menu list, and "split button and menu tree ↻ after an engine fix each". Both fixes have merged: the split button on 19 Nov (#21430), the menu's tree store on 18 Nov (#21434). On `dev` `78013b10fc` the group still shows only the button and the menu list as tiles; `examples/button/split` and `examples/menu/tree` have no record.

## The Problem

A visitor who opens the group sees two of the four components it promised. The two missing ones are exactly those the lane repaired for this purpose ([its rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980244557), corrections 3 and 5: "tiles ↻, fixes first").

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/button/Split.mjs` and `examples/button/split`; `src/menu/List.mjs` with a tree store and `examples/menu/tree` (last changed in August 2026).
- A tile is a record with `kind: 'component'` that opens on the workbench, with a crop cover from the recipe in `neomjs/pages`.
- The paging toolbar needs nothing here: #21447 shows it through `grid-server-side`'s `alsoIn`.

## The Fix

Drive both examples on `dev` at both sizes. Renew what the drive finds (a believable label set, a menu tree with real entries three levels deep), then publish each as a tile with its record and crop cover. One pull request for both.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both examples open on the workbench, with their inspector's configs as controls.
- [ ] The split button opens its menu from its trigger and fires its main action from its button; the menu tree opens its submenus by pointer and by keyboard.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, in every theme the group's tiles offer.
- [ ] Two records with `kind: 'component'` in Buttons, Menus & Toolbars, each with a crop cover (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: one frame per tile's stage at both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

A card for `toolbar/paging` (decided in #21447). The application toolbar (#21448).
